title: Our Bad Tasting Water is Still Bad...No Improvement While Using the Brita Pitcher
text:
Our Bad Tasting Water is Still Bad...No Improvement While Using the Brita Pitcher. 10 years ago, we moved into a new home. At our old home, we had the BEST tap water ever. There was absolutely no need for us to buy bottled water, our tap water was that good and refreshing. At our new and current home, we had a different water provider. Gone was our delicious tap water. It was replaced with awful tasting water. Our home has a whole home water softener. But its a waste. It doesn't help at all. Our tap water is still awful. It leaves blue-green rings in the toilet bowl, bathtub and on the dishes back when we still used the dishwasher. (Dishwasher broke, never replaced it as I don't mind doing dishes by hand) Of course the water company says the water is at an acceptable quality. Less than two years after we moved into this home, our normally healthy dog got terribly sick and had to be put to sleep . He was in full kidney failure. He never had any problems before. We've gone through 3 hot water heaters in the 10 years that we've lived here. When we moved to this home, we brought our almost 3 year old washing machine along. It stopped working less than 2 years after moving here. All of these things could, of course, be coincidence. But its my belief all of these things are due to our terrible water. Weeks after we lost our dog, a spring water stand was built close to our home. From that moment on, we completely stopped using tap water for drinking/cooking and began to use ONLY spring water. (Still had to use tap water to bathe, etc) And we only give our pets spring water to drink as well.

I was anxious to try the Brita pitcher. I hoped that it would make our tap water taste better and we'd be able to drink it. I had no problems whatsoever with the pitcher, it was easy to use. But we just did NOT notice any kind of new or better taste to our tap water that was in the Brita pitcher. My husband and I think the tap water from the pitcher tastes the same way our tap water has always tasted . There is no improvement. The Brita pitcher didn't work for us.
